name: autopilotDeployments
description: Windows Autopilot deployment results with their state, duration and failure details (beta API, recent deployments only)

metadata.name: totalDurationSeconds
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const m = /^P(?:([0-9]+)D)?(?:T(?:([0-9]+)H)?(?:([0-9]+)M)?(?:([0-9.]+)S)?)?$/.exec(typeof $['deploymentTotalDuration'] === 'string' ? $['deploymentTotalDuration'] : ''); return m ? Number(m[1] || 0) * 86400 + Number(m[2] || 0) * 3600 + Number(m[3] || 0) * 60 + Number(m[4] || 0) : null; })() }}

Number(m[1] || 0) * 86400 + Number(m[2] || 0) * 3600 + Number(m[3] || 0) * 60 + Number(m[4] || 0) : null; })() }}
